newsitem.title: USA: Whittman-Hart gets $3.5 mln Tuthill deal.
newsitem.headline: Whittman-Hart gets $3.5 mln Tuthill deal.

text.p: Whittman-Hart Inc said Wednesday it was awarded a $3.5 million contract from Tuthill Corp to implement a resource planning system.
Whittman-Hart said it would integrate Tuthill's sales, distribution, manufacturing and financial processes throughout its 21 divisions worldwide.
Whittman-Hart provides information technology consulting and systems integration services.
Tuthill, based in Hinsdale, Ill., makes pumps, turbines, plastics and electronic equipment.
